name: Reel roulette
summary: Every 'we should do this' reel the chat saved runs as a film strip through a little projector; spin and it stops one on the screen, spending your one veto stamps it and spins again, and locking makes it the weekend plan.
useWhen: we have like 20 saved reels and never do any of them
pick one of the reels we saved for saturday
spin for what we do this weekend from the chat's saved stuff
someone pick a reel plan already, i'm tired of deciding
random reel from the ones we sent each other, make it the plan
dontUseWhen: one reel that should become a plan (use reel-to-try)
ranking reels by how funny they were (use reel-rank)
a bucket list of everything the group wants to do (use reel-bucket)

saved.description: How many reels were saved in total

day.description: The day the landed reel becomes the plan for

kind.description: Drawing: ramen, pizza, burger, taco, boba, coffee, cocktail, icecream, cake, park, venue, campus, house, storefront and the other thumb kinds

history.description: Spins already done, oldest first; every one but the last must have a veto
